beats.en: King Bruce of Scotland lies down alone and sad. Though he is a king and wears a crown, his heart is sinking, because he has tried again and again to do a great deed that would make his people glad, and has failed.

textbookBox.concept: In flung himself down in low despair, the word low shows how deep his sadness was, and flung shows the physical expression of his mood. Pondered means thought.
